notes.title: Bug fixes! | Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Just a small little patch with a couple fixes!

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with space bar activating previously pressed buttons alongside shutters, now it only activates shutters as intended
[*] Fixed some layering issues with the moons in the sky
[*] Jupiter no longer gets illuminated for 1 frame when the night cycle animation loops
[/list]

notes.title: Quality-of-Life Additions and Bug Fixes! | Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone who's been playing Jovian Drive! An extra thank you to the people who have let me know about my many failings(bugs), haha. This update fixes a bunch of bugs people (and myself) have caught since release, along with some quality-of-life additions that some people suggested! I wish you all nice relaxing drives across the Jovian moons in this new update!

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added fullscreen option
[*] Added tutorial
[*] Added support for arrow keys
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Steering wheel no longer goes back to neutral position while vehicle is still turning under certain combinations of button presses
[*] Europa plume droplets can no longer hit the windshield when the shutters are down
[*] The sound of Europa plume droplets hitting the windshield now plays in-sync with the animation
[*] Pressing the space bar to close the shutters only worked after closing it with the mouse at least once, this is fixed now
[*] Io volcanos will now cause a game over if you don't close the shutters, I don't know how I missed the fact that this didn't work before release
[/list]
